game_concept: A action puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Lantern Square, a lantern-lit square: the snow ranger must handle ice wolves while practicing functions. Core idea – Library Builder: Combine small functions into a reusable library the snow ranger calls throughout the level.
theme: Snowy Hold – Lantern Square: a lantern-lit square
core_gameplay_loop: In Lantern Square, repeat each round: Combine small functions into a reusable library the snow ranger calls throughout the level. Each round, a new ice picks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the library value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 140 points of ice picks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 140, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 2 (intro tier): Library Builder
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Library Builder' (Week 6 slot 14), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Lantern Square'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how library changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice wolves in Lantern Square.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 140 within 33 seconds.
